FN-TOSE55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 219
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/24/2023
Senate Bill 219 as introduced allows for the use of federally accepted alternative refrigerants to
be used in various appliances. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
